items.title: 32.10 Raw Materials in Pakistan (Pakistan ka kaccha maal) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 32.10, printed page 238 (PDF 241).

blocks.text: Pakistan ke paas kai raw materials (kaccha maal) hain jo is ki chemical industries ke liye ahem hain. Kisi industry ka feedstock (woh kaccha maal jis se cheez banti hai) tay karta hai ke industry kahan lagegi aur economically viable (maali taur par faide wali) hogi ya nahi.

Hawa fertilizers ke liye nitrogen aur steel banane ke liye oxygen deti hai. Paani solvent (ghoolne wala liquid), cooling agent (thanda karne wali cheez) aur hydrogen ke source (zariye) ke taur par use hota hai. Fossil fuels, jaise coal (koyla), oil (tel) aur natural gas (qudrati gas), woh hydrocarbons dete hain jin se 90% organic chemicals bante hain.
Pakistan ka geological profile (zameen ki banawat) unique (khaas) hai, jo kai chemical sub-sectors ko support (sahara) deta hai, maslan:

items: Natural Gas (qudrati gas): Yeh methane (CH₄) ka bara source (zariya) hai, jis se fertilizers (urea) aur petrochemicals bante hain. Yeh fuel bhi hai aur hydrogen ka zariya bhi.

Rock Salt (sendha namak, Khewra Mines): Khewra ki mines (kaanein) duniya ke sab se bare rock salt deposits (namak ke zakheeron) mein se hain. Yeh sodium chloride (NaCl) ka zariya hai, jo soda ash (Na₂CO₃), caustic soda (NaOH) aur chlorine banane ka kaccha maal hai.
Limestone (choona pathar): Salt Range aur Sindh mein bohat zyada (highly abundant) milta hai. Yeh cement industry ke liye calcium carbonate (CaCO₃) ka zariya hai.
Gypsum: Cement industry aur plaster banane mein use hota hai. Yeh calcium aur sulphur ka zariya bhi hai aur soil conditioner (mitti ko behtar banane wali cheez) mein bhi istemal hota hai.
Chromite: Muslim Bagh mein milta hai; stainless steel aur pigments (rang) banane mein use hota hai.
Crude Oil (kaccha tel): Isay refine (saaf) kar ke tarah tarah ke fuels aur petrochemicals banaye jaate hain.
Sulphur: Is se sulphuric acid (H₂SO₄) banta hai, jo industry ka aik bohat ahem chemical hai.

blocks.title: Did You Know? (kya aap jante hain?)
blocks.text: Pakistan ke paas bohat qudrati gas hai, jo urea (NH₂CONH₂) banane ka asal kaccha maal hai. Kaccha maal mulk mein hi (locally) milne se production cost (banane ka kharcha) kam aata hai, aur khaad kisanon ke liye sasti ho jaati hai.

blocks.prompt: Khewra ka kaun sa kaccha maal soda ash aur caustic soda banane mein use hota hai?

items: Hawa (N₂, O₂), paani aur fossil fuels (90% organic chemicals) basic raw materials hain.
Pakistan: natural gas, Khewra ka rock salt, limestone, gypsum, Muslim Bagh ka chromite, crude oil, sulphur.
Local gas se urea sasti banti hai.
